description: Annual benchmark, EvoST and matched controls on ten networks. values: mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1) over five evaluation seeds of the per-seed mean over years (each year weighted equally); strict metrics; MAPE in percent. Streams: frozen = same-year checkpoint without adaptation; frozen+RLS = with the per-sensor calibrator; refit = identities refreshed, no calibrator; EvoST = both.

EvoST vs frozen.unit: fraction; positive = lower error than the reference

frozen+RLS vs frozen.unit: fraction; positive = lower error than the reference

EvoST vs frozen+RLS.unit: fraction; positive = lower error than the reference

refit vs frozen.unit: fraction; positive = lower error than the reference
